name: toctou
title: Avoid check-then-use races on paths
lesson: A path can change between a separate check and the later open or use.
fix_goal: Operate on the opened descriptor rather than trusting a prior path check.
fix_steps: Avoid separate access/stat checks before opening a pathname.
Open securely and verify properties through the resulting descriptor.
Re-run the lab and confirm the check-then-use pattern is gone.
